name: timeouts set by hand: the two calls whose tries cannot fit, the deadline first, each with the per-try timeout that fits

input.chain:
frontend -> checkout    none   2
checkout -> pricing     1s     2
pricing -> inventory    500ms  2

why: Each number was printed first by service-mesh/timeout_budget.py in mainlog-code, which does the same arithmetic in Python. The timeouts are the same arithmetic solved for each call: (2.00 s - 2 x 25 ms) / 3 tries is 650 ms, and (1.00 s - 2 x 25 ms) / 3 is 316 ms.
